description:
7 real events so bizarre they sound made up — a wave of molasses taller than a house, meat raining from a clear blue sky, and trousers that spontaneously exploded. All 100% true.

I'm Bo, and I scored each one out of 10 on the Weirdness Face-Off — from the Dancing Plague of 1518 to the Tunguska sky explosion of 1908 — and crowned ONE champion at the end. Honestly? I had to read some of these twice. Which one would YOU least want to live through?

CHAPTERS:
00:02 Hook: The Sticky Wave That Killed 21
00:50 Round 1: The Dancing Plague of 1518
02:05 Round 2: The Kentucky Meat Shower
03:20 Round 3: The London Beer Flood
04:32 Round 4: The Great Molasses Flood
05:44 Round 5: Exploding Trousers
06:43 Round 6: Tunguska, the Sky Bomb
08:03 Final Round: The Rain of Fish
10:02 The Verdict: Weirdest Moment Ever

If history this weird is your thing, subscribe to Weird World Daily — new weirdness every single day. Drop your champion in the comments and defend it. I read everything.

▶ Watch next: 7 Places on Earth That Look Completely FAKE — https://youtu.be/5hHQlZvoYqk

#weirdfacts #didyouknow #viral #history #foryou
title: 7 Times Real History Went Completely BONKERS
